title: GIS Map Online RendererSpec
description: A declarative layer style. GIS Map Online compiles it to an ArcGIS renderer, computing class breaks from the layer's data. Not sure which style suits a field? Use { "type": "auto", "field": ... } or "method": "auto" and the app decides from the data. Field names must match the service's fields exactly (sources.inspect(url).fields lists them).

oneOf.description: Keep the publisher's own style (the default).

size.description: Marker size in points (points and lines). Default 8.

oneOf.description: Colour features by a numeric field in classes (a choropleth for polygons). Values listed in exclude, and nulls, are drawn grey as "No data" and kept out of the classes.

normalizeBy.description: A numeric field to divide by (for rates, such as per area or per person).

oneOf.description: Size point or line symbols by a numeric field. Polygon layers get a choropleth instead (with a warning).

ramp.description: Optional colour ramp combined with symbol sizes.

oneOf.description: One colour per value of a field (the most common values; the rest are "Other").

colors.description: Colours for particular values, such as { "Active": "#d9951e" }.

oneOf.description: A heat map of point density, optionally weighted by a numeric field. Point layers only.

field.description: A numeric field to weight by.

oneOf.description: Raw ArcGIS renderer JSON, for styles the other types cannot express.

json.description: ArcGIS renderer JSON (as layer.renderer.toJSON() writes it).

oneOf.description: Let the app choose the style from the data when the map opens: colours or sized symbols with the break method that suits the values (quantile for skewed values, natural breaks for clusters, equal interval for even spreads), or categories for a text field. Without a field, the most measurement-like field is used. Saving or sharing from the app records the chosen style with its breaks.

classes.description: Number of classes (default: 3 to 5, by feature count).

method.description: How class breaks are chosen. "auto" picks from the values: quantile when they are skewed, natural breaks when they cluster, equal interval when they are spread evenly.

breaks.description: Fixed classes: the upper bound of each, in increasing order, such as [1000, 50000, 250000]. They replace classes and method, so the map looks the same whenever it opens. Values below the first bound join the first class; values above the last join the last.

ramp.description: A named colour ramp, light to dark (diverging ramps run low to high).

exclude.description: Values that are codes rather than measurements, such as -1 for "Not Disclosed". When omitted, the layer's detected sentinels are used.
